title: 000 激活码001 第一杀
content_zh:
地球OL 000 激活码
人们都说命运弄人，但其实更多的是自己不去争取，但眼下却有一个真正被命运玩弄的可怜人，因为他连争取的机会都没有，至少至今为止还没有。
这青年叫关雨，名字的发音和关二爷一模一样，只是名字多了一份柔润，少了三分霸气。
他算是孤儿，但又不算是孤儿。
归根到底还是他的父母年纪太大，大的创造了奇迹。
他的父亲关中天，74岁，他的母亲侯静雨68岁，当年侯静雨怀胎还惊动了媒体，大肆报道过后被称之为生命的奇迹！
但这奇迹并没有给这大龄产妇多少好运，侯静雨十月怀胎之后因为难产去世，唯一值得庆幸的是现在医学昌明，关雨却是顺利的来到了这个世界上，但命运却依然不放过他，因为侯静雨的死，受到巨大打击的关中天突发脑溢血晕倒，两天后在昏迷中魂归西天。
但如果仅仅如此，还不算什么，但关雨有个缺德的大哥，这大哥还真的很大，已经50多岁，儿子都已经20来岁。
这大哥在关中天死去的第二天就带着全家卷走了所有的财产，一下子就音信全无，原本应该算是小少爷的关雨顿时成了没人爱的可怜娃。
不过这种情况下，按照狗血剧情的套路，也总得有个老管家会接手照顾这可怜的小少爷。
果然狗血剧情总有其狗血的道理，关雨还真被一个曾经在关家做司机的老人收养了。
这老人也是可怜，一辈子没有成家，连个伴儿都没有，含辛茹苦的抚养关雨到十二岁，终于还是撒手人寰，从那一天开始，关雨就不得不依靠自己小小的双手撑起自己头顶那并不大的天空。
这一撑就是八年，二十岁的关雨身高一米八，样子看上去还过得去，因为成绩不错技术过关被一家靠近大学的网吧招聘为网管，白天上课晚上工作，小日子倒还过得去，加上这厮平时努力，成绩倒没落下，在班上虽然不显眼，但风评还不错。
此时他就刚刚从网吧里下班，天还蒙蒙亮，他打着哈欠往学校宿舍方向走去，准备在早晨好好补补觉。
但这时候一阵风吹来，一张门票大小的纸张顺风贴到他的脸上，他顿时眼睛一黑。
随手将脸上的纸张拿到手里，如果一般人的话可能会顺手扔掉，但关雨却会看一看，到底是什么玩意，当然，最好就是软妹币了。
关雨两手拿着这门票大小的纸张，只见上面写着：《地球ol》这是世界上最大的真人大型角色扮演游戏，此游戏经过六次封测，完善了大部分的bug，在不久的将来，封测将会结束，届时所有玩家都将拥有把握自己命运的机会，而你，没错就是你，却拥有着超越亿万玩家的一个机遇。
随后下面是写着一行小字：这是《地球ol》不删档终极封测激活码，只需撕开本激活码，即时激活游戏！
“神经病！”关雨看了忍不住嘀咕道，在网络上早就有所谓的《地球ol》，实际上就是一群疯子将这个世界当成游戏来玩，但对于关雨而言，生活却要现实的多，哪有这样的闲情，有功夫还不如多写几篇论文，卖给某些富二代赚点外快。
他随手就要将这激活码扔掉，但忽然想了想，又没有扔掉，而是撕碎了再猛的一抛，顿时纸屑如同仙女散花随风飘开，不得不说，其实他心底还是存着一点点不带理智的念头，当然他自己是不会承认自己还幼稚的相信奇迹。

“激活你妹！”关雨骂了一声将心里的郁闷等等都发泄出来，继续向前走，这世界哪里还有奇迹，祈祷无数次的关雨早就已经接受了现实。
但一会儿的时间过后，他还没有走出十步耳边就传来一声：“滴！！”
仿佛是电脑开启的声音，随即他就呆住了，他眼前此时出现了一块半透明的面板！
“我的天，难道真撞大运了？”关雨目瞪口呆的看着这面板，一瞬间睡意全无。
这半透明的面板底色是淡蓝，大概和手提电脑的屏幕差不多大小，只见上面写着：“欢迎关雨玩家进入游戏，您的id是0号！”
关雨看到id心里顿时更加的惊喜，零号那就代表着他是第一个进入游戏的玩家，虽然不清楚这个游戏是什么游戏，但这绝对不是现在科技能够办到的。
他伸手尝试触碰这面板，但却直接穿过，面板上面顿时产生一阵涟漪。
画面开始变化，随后化为一个有无数选项的面板。
“属性！”关雨低声念道，但面板并没有任何的变化，他再试着用手去点，果然出现了属性：
——————
姓名:关雨
性别：男
年龄：20
状态：健康
阵营：天朝
主职：大学生
副职：网管
称号：关二爷（附加属性：幸运+1，魅力2）
生命：100100
体力：100100

精力：100100
寿命：6585
复活点：0
幸运：？（隐藏属性）
————
阶级：健壮
力量：10
敏捷：12
精神：9
体能：15
智力：105（一般情况固定不变）
潜能点：0
————
体温：37℃
攻击：10
防御：2
速度：8
————
技能：无
————

装备：金丝猴眼镜（视力范围+1）普通衬衫（温度+3）普通牛仔裤（温度+5，防御+2）
————
成就：三好学生
少年先锋队队员
五道杠少年
————
坐骑：杂牌自行车（速度+20）
——————
看着长长的属性，关雨吞了吞口水，这下真的撞大运了，以目前的科技绝对无法做到现在这种效果，所以他可以肯定这是大机遇啊！
身为底层的小屁民，看网络小说自然不会少，毕竟他宿舍里面就有人天天追看网络小说，而他当网管有时候也会看看。
不过这《地球ol》恐怕不久之后就要公测，毕竟那激活码上面写着是终极封测，而且还是不删档的。
所以现在他第一时间就应该弄清楚这个游戏该怎么玩，怎么才能够领先别人一步。
需要拿着钱包穿过屏幕就可以将钱包放入包裹之中。
“不错，就是小了一些。”关雨有点兴奋，毕竟这太不可思议了。
人和猴子其实很相似，遇到新奇的东西都会兴致勃勃的玩弄，但时间一长就完全没兴趣了。
就像你得到一台新手机，你会时不时的拿出来把玩，但几天后你就不会这样做了。
“居然有任务，看看！”关雨立即点击任务，0名，完成任务：奖励随机技能一个，失败：成为丧尸！
关雨看着这任务，脸色一下子苍白了，你妹的，这任务也太坑爹了吧，居然要他杀人，而且还不是满大街的国人，还要是其他国家的人，毕竟他已经看过属性，知道所谓的阵营恐怕就是国家。
他的阵营是天朝，自然不能杀天朝的人，虽然天朝的人最多，也最好找。
怎么办呢？

关雨所在的燕海市算是国际化的大都市，但外国人依然很少见，唯一让他想到的就是学校里面的几个外语教授。
三十天以内必须完成任务，否则可就是变成丧尸。
成为第一个玩家，关雨可不想再成为第一个丧尸，这个任务必须完成。
而且他并不笨，既然他能够得到激活码，恐怕还会有人得到激活码，任务那么变态，别人未必能够完成，到时候变成丧尸的话，世界末日恐怕就不远了！
丧尸有多变态，他看电影已经见识过不少，尤其是那恐怖的感染能力。
虽然任务很艰难，但却也是一个机遇，奖励的可是技能！
即使是随机的技能，但总比别人走快了一步，如果幸运的话，得到好的技能，甚至可以抛开以后的玩家。
关雨思考过后，双眼顿时散发着疯狂的光芒，这破生活，他受够了！！
“从此以后，我的命运由我不由天！！”关雨紧握拳头坚定的说道，以前他就很喜欢这句话，只不过窝囊的生活压迫的他喘不过气来，他只能默默的做着小屁民，但现在……一切将要颠覆！
虽然他不知道这个游戏是什么样的力量在维持运作，也不知道背后的目的，但他知道，这是他唯一能够把握命运的机会！
关雨关闭面板，慢慢的走回学校，最后进到宿舍，只见几个同学都还在呼呼大睡，电风扇挂在天花板上面疯狂的转动，发出‘呼呼呼’的声音。
对于某些人而言，大学就是度假场所，但对于关雨而言则是翻盘的一个途径。成为大学生，拿到毕业证才能够找到一份更好的工作，这是他以前的梦想，不过现在已经不是了。
关雨洗了个冷水澡，然后躺在自己的床上，没有吵醒其他人，其实虽然同一个宿舍，他和这几个同学的感情并没有一些网络小说描写的那么好，大家相交反而有点君子之交淡如水的感觉，见面也就是互相点点头，偶尔客气的说说话，大家都已经有一种特殊的隔阂。
关雨此时满脑子都是怎么寻找目标，怎么下手，再哪里能够弄到工具，想的非常多，渐渐就这样进入梦乡。
——————
开新书了，大家多多捧场
content_en:
Earth OL 000 activation code
People say that fate plays tricks on people, but in fact, it’s more about not fighting for it. But now there is a poor man who is really played by fate, because he doesn’t even have a chance to fight for it, at least not yet.
This young man's name is Guan Yu. The pronunciation of his name is exactly the same as Guan Erye's, but his name is a little more gentle and less domineering.
He is considered an orphan, but not quite an orphan.
In the final analysis, his parents are too old, and the older ones have created miracles.
His father, Guan Zhongtian, is 74 years old, and his mother, Hou Jingyu, is 68 years old. When Hou Jingyu became pregnant, the media shocked the media. After extensive reports, it was called a miracle of life!
But this miracle did not bring much good luck to this older woman. Hou Jingyu passed away due to dystocia after being pregnant in ten months. The only thing to be thankful for is that with the advancement of medical science, Guan Yu came to this world smoothly, but fate still refused to let him go. Because of Hou Jingyu's death, Guan Zhongtian, who was hit hard by the death of Hou Jingyu, suddenly fainted from a cerebral hemorrhage, and passed away in a coma two days later.
But if that's all, it's nothing. But Guan Yu has a wicked eldest brother. This eldest brother is really big. He is already over 50 years old, and his son is already in his 20s.
The eldest brother took away all the property with his family the day after Guan Zhongtian's death, and there was no news at all. Guan Yu, who was supposed to be a young master, suddenly became a pitiful child that no one loved.
However, in this case, according to the bloody plot, there must be an old housekeeper who will take over the care of the poor young master.
Sure enough, the bloody plot always has its bloody truth. Guan Yu was actually adopted by an old man who used to work as a driver in the Guan family.
This old man was also pitiful. He never got married or even had a companion. He worked hard to raise Guan Yu until he was twelve years old, and finally passed away. From that day on, Guan Yu had to rely on his small hands to hold up the small sky above his head.
This lasted for eight years. Twenty-year-old Guan Yu was 1.8 meters tall and looked pretty good. Because of his good grades and passing technical skills, he was recruited as a network administrator by an Internet cafe near the university. He attended classes during the day and worked at night. His life was not bad. In addition to his hard work, his grades did not fall behind. Although he was not conspicuous in the class, his reputation was not bad.
At this time, he had just gotten off work from the Internet cafe, and it was still dark. He yawned and walked towards the school dormitory, preparing to catch up on his sleep in the morning.
But then a gust of wind blew, and a piece of paper the size of a ticket was stuck to his face, and his eyes suddenly went dark.
He casually took the paper on his face into his hand. An ordinary person would probably throw it away, but Guan Yu would take a look and see what it was. Of course, it would be best if it was a soft girl coin.
Guan Yu held the ticket-sized piece of paper in both hands, and saw what was written on it: "Earth OL" This is the world's largest live-action large-scale role-playing game. This game has gone through six closed beta tests, and most of the bugs have been improved. In the near future, the closed beta test will end. At that time, all players will have the opportunity to control their own destiny, and you, that's right, you have an opportunity to surpass hundreds of millions of players.
Then there is a line of small words written below: This is the ultimate closed beta activation code for "Earth OL" without deletion. Just tear open this activation code and activate the game instantly!
"Crazy!" Guan Yu couldn't help but muttered after watching it. There has been a so-called "Earth OL" on the Internet for a long time. In fact, it is a group of lunatics who play this world as a game. But for Guan Yu, life is much more realistic. There is no such leisure. If you have time, you might as well write a few more papers and sell them to some rich second generation to make some extra money.
He was about to throw away the activation code, but suddenly he thought about it and instead of throwing it away, he tore it into pieces and threw it violently. Suddenly, the confetti flew away in the wind like fairy flowers. It had to be said that in fact, he still had a little bit of it in his heart.It was an irrational thought. Of course, he himself would not admit that he still believed in miracles naively.
"Activate your sister!" Guan Yu cursed and vented all the depression in his heart, etc., and continued to move forward. There are no miracles in this world. Guan Yu, who has prayed countless times, has already accepted the reality.
But after a while, before he had taken ten steps, he heard a sound in his ear: "Beep!!"
It sounded like the sound of a computer turning on, and then he froze. A translucent panel appeared in front of him!
"Oh my god, is this really lucky?" Guan Yu stared at the panel in stunned silence, feeling completely sleepless for a moment.
The background color of this translucent panel is light blue, which is about the same size as a laptop screen. It reads: "Welcome Guan Yu players to enter the game, your ID is No. 0!"
Guan Yu was even more surprised when he saw ID. Number Zero meant that he was the first player to enter the game. Although he didn't know what the game was, this was definitely not something that current technology could do.
He reached out and tried to touch the panel, but it went right through, causing ripples to appear on the panel.
The screen began to change, and then turned into a panel with countless options.
"Attributes!" Guan Yu muttered in a low voice, but there was no change in the panel. He tried to click on it with his hand again, and sure enough the attributes appeared:
——————
Name: Guan Yu
Gender: Male
Age: 20
Status: healthy
Faction: Celestial Dynasty
Main job: College student
Deputy position: network administrator
Title: Guan Erye (Additional attributes: Luck +1, Charm 2)
Life: 100100

Lucky:? (hidden attribute)
————
Class: Robust
Strength: 10
Agility: 12

Physical fitness: 15
Intelligence: 105 (generally fixed)
Potential points: 0
————
Body temperature: 37℃
Attack: 10
Defense: 2
Speed: 8
————
Skills: None
————
Equipment: golden monkey glasses (vision range +1) ordinary shirt (temperature +3) ordinary jeans (temperature +5, defense +2)
————
Achievements: Three good students
Young Pioneers
Five stripes boy
————
Mount: Miscellaneous Bicycle (Speed +20)
——————
Looking at the long list of attributes, Guan Yu swallowed his saliva. This time he really got lucky. With the current technology, it is absolutely impossible to achieve this effect, so he can be sure that this is a big opportunity!
As a low-class kid, he naturally reads a lot of online novels. After all, there are people in his dormitory who read online novels every day, and he sometimes reads them when he is a network administrator.
However, "Earth OL" will probably be in public beta soon. After all, the activation code says it is the ultimate closed beta, and the files will not be deleted.
So now he should figure out how to play this game as soon as possible and how to stay one step ahead of others.
You only need to hold the wallet through the screen to put the wallet into the package.
"Not bad, just a little smaller." Guan Yu was a little excited, after all, this was incredible.
Humans and monkeys are actually very similar. They will play with novel things with great interest, but as time goes by, they will lose interest at all.
Just like when you get a new mobile phone, you will take it out and play with it from time to time, but after a few days you won't do so anymore.
"There is actually a mission, look!" Guan Yu immediately clicked on the mission, 0 people, completed the mission: rewarded with a random skill, failed: became a zombie!
Guan Yu looked at this task and his face suddenly turned pale. Damn it, this task is too cheating. It actually requires him to kill people, and they are not just Chinese people in the street, but people from other countries. After all, he has seen the attributes and knows that the so-called camp is probably the country.Home.
His camp is the Celestial Dynasty, so naturally he cannot kill people from the Celestial Dynasty, even though the Celestial Dynasty has the most people and is the easiest to find.
What to do?
Yanhai City, where Guan Yu is located, can be considered an international metropolis, but foreigners are still rare. The only ones that reminded him were a few foreign language professors in the school.
The task must be completed within thirty days, otherwise you may become a zombie.
Becoming the first player, Guan Yu doesn't want to be the first zombie again. This task must be completed.
And he is not stupid. Since he can get the activation code, I am afraid that someone else will get the activation code. The task is so abnormal, others may not be able to complete it. If he turns into a zombie by then, the end of the world may not be far away!
He has seen a lot of how perverted zombies are by watching movies, especially their terrifying ability to infect.
Although the task is difficult, it is also an opportunity, and the reward is skills!
Even if it is a random skill, it is always one step faster than others. If you are lucky and get good skills, you can even leave behind future players.
After Guan Yu thought about it, his eyes suddenly glowed with madness. He had had enough of this broken life! !
"From now on, my destiny is up to me!!" Guan Yu clenched his fists and said firmly. He liked this sentence very much before, but the useless life oppressed him and he couldn't breathe. He could only be a little bitch silently, but now... everything will be overturned!
Although he doesn't know what kind of power maintains the operation of this game, nor does he know the purpose behind it, he knows that this is his only chance to grasp his destiny!
Guan Yu closed the panel, walked slowly back to the school, and finally entered the dormitory. He saw several classmates still sleeping soundly, and the electric fan hanging on the ceiling was spinning crazily, making a "whirring" sound.
For some people, university is a place for vacation, but for Guan Yu, it is a way to make a comeback. It was his dream before to become a college student and get a diploma before he could find a better job, but it is no longer the case.
Guan Yu took a cold shower and then lay on his bed without waking anyone else up. In fact, although they were in the same dormitory, the relationship between him and these classmates was not as good as described in some online novels. The relationship between them was a bit like the friendship between gentlemen. When they met, they just nodded to each other and occasionally spoke politely. Everyone already had a special barrier.
At this time, Guan Yu's mind was full of how to find the target, how to start, and where to get the tools. He thought a lot, and gradually fell asleep like this.
——————
A new book has been published, please support me a lot
